propositions: Duplicate CAS push retry loops in multiple workflows are consolidated into a single Python core implementation at src/rebar/_store/push.py
The strict=False default preserves best-effort behavior for existing Python library, CLI, MCP, and importer callers while workflows opt into strict delivery explicitly

Workflow adapters delegate exactly once to Python core entrypoints (push_tickets_branch with strict=True for canary, commit_and_push_tickets_branch for bridge) and no longer contain their own fetch/merge/retry loops
Strict delivery raises PushDeliveryError with typed failure reason and nonzero adapter exit status after exhausting a five-cycle retry budget
The locked commit-and-push transaction preserves working-tree state, supports dirty-tree handling, and maintains bot identity and commit subject contracts
All three child changes (strict push semantics, locked commit-and-push, workflow cutovers) are merged and verified with no persisted schema changes required
